question: Should the independent silicon SCF CPN Task use the pinned tutorial's self-contained fixed geometry and already-local canonical-equivalent pseudopotential without first executing the separate structure-optimization tutorial?

options.summary: Use the pinned fixed DOS inputs in a local run-only realization.
options.consequence: Treat celldm(1)=10.2076 Bohr as an immutable tutorial input, revise the DOS Workflow so structure optimization is not a computational prerequisite for its SCF Task, and permit local run-only staging of each Task's identity-checked source input plus the already-local pseudopotential whose canonical XML equals the pinned source artifact. SCF, NSCF, and DOS remain separate Task instances with immutable state handoffs. Do not redistribute source files or invoke a scientific executable until a separate exact execution checkpoint is approved.

Keep the DOS Task blocked, preflight and separately authorize the structure-optimization tutorial first, and return for a later decision about whether its observed geometry or the pinned DOS geometry governs the DOS input. This adds a protected calculation and may cease to be an exact realization of the pinned DOS input.
Retain the read-only preflight and make no Task-dependency, source-staging, or execution change. Calculator-stage and DOS-artifact behavior remain unobserved.

recommendation: Option A, because the pinned SCF input already contains the fixed geometry and consumes no relaxation artifact. It is the smallest realization that can observe the requested SCF-to-NSCF-to-dos.x behavior while keeping the geometry tutorial-only and requiring a separate protected-execution authorization.
blocked_scope: Workflow dependency revision, local run-only staging of the pinned tutorial inputs and canonical-equivalent already-local pseudopotential, and all SCF, NSCF, and dos.x execution.
safe_scope: Read-only source, input, pseudopotential, executable, resource, and provenance inspection; private effect-free reusable CPN Task-contract design and software verification; preflight validation; and reporting.
normalized_decision: Option B selected: preserve the structure-optimization prerequisite, keep the DOS Workflow blocked, preflight and separately authorize the structure-optimization tutorial first, and return for a later decision about which geometry governs the DOS SCF Task.
authorized_scope: Complete the read-only preflight and protected-execution checkpoint for the exact silicon structure-optimization tutorial Task. Do not invoke pw.x until that separate checkpoint is resolved. Keep the DOS Workflow blocked and do not select its SCF geometry until the structure-optimization disposition is available and a later human decision is recorded.
